# Paid thermal scalar qualification: construction and its limits

The output is a set of finite, correlated-record classification contracts
and actual directed scalar inputs. It is NOT a measured physical decision.
The missing instrument/bath/calibration premises stay explicit. Strong
ordinary source-aware Gibbs inference, passive calibration and driven
mean measurements receive the same information.

## 1. Locked scientific accesses and root input review

The two assigned sources have N32, p1,v32, theta1, Delta1/2 and exactly
one unknown quartic alpha at v. Their matrices are SEPARATE warranted
accesses, K3=3I-A_path and K2=2I-A_path. K2 still has the boundary
pinning encoded by its literal matrix; an ungrounded singular graph
Laplacian is not substituted. All other quartics are known absent.

The model is `dX=-grad V dt+sqrt(2theta)dW`, V=X^TKX/2+alpha Xv^4/4,
with calibrated Euclidean mobility and distributed independent bath
noise at EVERY node. It is not automatically an RC Johnson-noise law.
No actual device, zero initialization, temperature record, gain, readout
or physical conversion of model time units has been acquired.

Root's `root_thermal_probe/PROOF.txt` was whole-read. Gaussian elimination,
the scalar monotonicity/derivative, nonasymptotic positive signal bound,
Gaussian moment domination, gap/read bounds and zero/general-initial
coupling are sound at their stated interfaces. The event calculation
in its loose derivative floor gives the claimed9/(128pi) constant.
Mobility/temperature factors are consistent. In particular the variance
contrast is

    s_alpha=(g/d)^2[theta d-v(alpha)],
    g=R_pv, d=R_vv, b=R_pp, R=K^-1,
    v(alpha)=Var_alpha Xv.

It increases with alpha. Both connected endpoint paths have g>0; a
disconnected port with g0 would not have a strict signal. The generic
strict-signal condition was made explicit in the updated BLUR_PROOF.
A's archived earlier BLUR input remains historical; its actual connected
K3 source and frozen numerical interface are unchanged.

The independent scalar input is `MOMENTS.json`. Write

    z=Xv/sqrt(theta d), beta=alpha theta d^2,
    I_m(beta)=integral_0^infinity z^m exp(-z^2/2-beta z^4/4)dz.

Then v(Delta)=theta d I2/I0 and

source_excerpts.text:
# Completed conditional thermal receiver and capability judgment

The directed one-dimensional moments and full finite-record budget
compiler are executed. No physical data, calibration or device is
supplied. `receive.py` consequently returns NO_QUALIFIED_PHYSICAL_RECORD.
The governing theorem, correlated statistics, initialization, calibration
and strong same-model comparison are in `PROOF.md`.

At the assigned N32,theta1,Delta.5 endpoint source, the actual stationary
variance contrasts are4.99059151e-28(K3) and0.000388977849(K2). Long
exposures preserve a qualified constant fraction while reducing detector
and thermal background. Exact known-spectrum references, PSD/duration
electronics, correlated blocks and zero-start transient are paid.

The useful qualification improvement is explicit: on K2 a coarse PSD
upper alone suffices for the square-score plan. It requires937983404
raw reads over at most4.6118031e11 MODEL time units, with remaining
combined score-mean calibration error below2.7557e-5. Its zero extra
burn-in is justified by averaging the bounded transient over this long
finite record, not by asserting an IID/stationary start. K3's equivalent
coarse-noise variance rule fails. A noise-variance-insensitive adjacent
product is constructed, but its K3 sufficient cost is1.8249e57 reads.

With fully calibrated electronics variance, the long-window K2 plan
uses749115554 reads and3.6832e11 model time units. A SAME-bath ordinary
driven-mean plan at U1 already needs slightly less time3.5648e11.
Allowing U33 gives2.8844e8, while charging peak33, reference displacement32,
recoverable reference loading energy528 and the corresponding calibration
and actuator/linear-range obligations. Thus a passive algorithmic winner
does not survive the strongest actual same-model comparison.

The no-internal-bath DC comparator also receives the exact one-quartic
promise. It can use fixed U1; it is not compared at T's more restrictive
all-quartic amplitude. High peak U1/g is not forbidden, and stored energy
is not mislabeled irreversible power or full-cycle work. Different bath
accesses remain distinct from same-hardware algorithms.

The positive mathematical operation is a finite-exposure, all-alpha,
correlated-record qualification receiver with actual scalar inputs and
an electronics-calibration trade-off. For K2 its sufficient long-window
scaling improves to O(N4) duration
